desc:
Fumble is a chaotic ragdoll ball game. Whoever has the ball has a target on their back. Run it to the glowing point, juke past everyone diving at you.

⭐ HOW IT WORKS
🏈 Pick up the ball: +1
📍 Deliver it to the point: +5
💥 Tackle whoever has it: +1
Most points at the end wins the round!

🔥 WHAT’S INSIDE
🕺 Juke tacklers and make them eat dirt
🤕 Real ragdoll tackles (yes, you can break a leg)
🗺️ 4 maps: Factory, Playground, Concrete Maze and Shipping Port, and more
🎬 End-of-round replays of the winner’s best play, in slow-mo as well
🏆 Awards, leaderboards and tags to flex
🎁 Crates with trails, ball skins, emotes and sounds
⚡ Powerups for when you have the ball… and when you don’t

🎮 CONTROLS
💻 PC: SPACE tackle / juke · CLICK drop the ball · E powerup · Q item · B emotes (1–8 for quick emotes) · T free mouse
🎮 Controller: A tackle / juke · R2 drop the ball · X powerup · Y item · D-pad down emotes

Hop in with friends, get clipped, get your revenge. 👀
